statement: We leave open the characterization of foliage graphs for each zombie number z > 2. For throttling numbers, a natural question to ask is whether our asymptotic bounds generalize for grids in higher dimensions. To start, one could study the graph G = □k Pn or G = ⊠k Pn and 1 determine whether the zombie-throttling number and/or cop-throttling number is Θ(|G| k+1 ). We believe that our techniques should also extend to obtain the same asymptotic bounds on the throttling numbers of the Cartesian torus Ca □Cb and the strong torus Ca ⊠ Cb .
